allow_instructions: Allow read-only Git inspection commands, including git status, git diff, git log, git show, and git branch --show-current.
Allow node ai/generator/generate.mjs --check and node ai/generator/generate.mjs --dry-run.
Allow the repository's dependency-free AI test commands.
Allow searches and reads confined to the current workspace.
block_instructions: Require approval for every command that accesses paths outside this workspace.
Require approval for every network request, package installation, dependency update, or download.
Require approval for every Git write operation, including commit, push, pull, merge, rebase, tag, remote, reset, or branch deletion.
Require approval before reading, printing, changing, or transmitting credentials, tokens, SSH material, environment files, or other sensitive data.
Require approval for commands that start long-running servers, containers, background processes, or browser automation.
Require approval for destructive filesystem operations or any command that deletes, overwrites, moves, or recursively changes files.
